parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr

summary: Forest land possession claim; Banwasi Seva Ashram precedent applicability to non-backward classes; High Court improper evidentiary reappreciation under Article 226; settlement officer's findings sustained; concurrent lower court findings not perverse; writ jurisdiction misuse for factual reevaluation; possession established through legacy documents since 1952.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; appellants' bhoomidar status restored; eviction order quashed.
